t: What is PooCoin? How to use the PooCoin App? Should you buy PooCoin Token in 2024?
s: October 9, 2024 - PooCoin is a platform built on the BNB Chain and was introduced to the cryptocurrency community in March 2021. This cryptocurrency takes its ideas from Dogecoin and is dubbed the next-generation Dogecoin. This platform was created in an effort to mock and rebut the term "shitcoin". That's why the platform allows users to track price movements, chart, buy and sell all kinds of meme coins and low-cap coins, which many investors see as "low-tier coins".
